defs.def: the flat surface at the front of a television, computer, or other electronic device, on which you see pictures or information 屏幕；荧光屏

ex.s: The parent argued that none of her friends’ parents let them have screens after 9 o’clock.
ex.t: 那位家长争辩说，她朋友的父母都不让孩子在9点后碰屏幕。

ex.s: Today’s children spend an average of four and a half hours a day looking at screens, split between watching television and using the Internet.
ex.t: 如今的孩子每天花在屏幕前的时间平均为四个半小时，分为看电视和上网。

ex.s: The dogs can go to the other side of the screen.
ex.t: 狗可以走到屏幕的另一侧。

ex.s: It does point out that many parents still limit electronic reading, mainly due to concerns about increased screen time.
ex.t: 它确实指出，许多父母仍然限制电子阅读，主要是出于对屏幕时间增加的担忧。

ex.s: They stay in front of screens for too long.
ex.t: 他们在屏幕前待的时间太长了。

ex.s: A comprehensive study of 4, 500 children conducted by the National Institutes of Health in 2018 shows that children who spent more than seven hours a day staring at screens showed evidence of premature thinning of their brain's cortex-the outer layer that processes sensory information.
ex.t: 美国国立卫生研究院2018年对4500名儿童进行的一项综合研究表明，每天盯着屏幕超过七小时的儿童，其大脑皮层的变薄迹象提前出现——大脑皮层是处理感官信息的外层。

ex.s: “But my screen time is off,” he said.
ex.t: “可我的屏幕使用时间已经用完了。”他说。

ex.s: Not too long ago, on a cold winter night, there was a teenager who wanted more screen time and a parent who said no.
ex.t: 不久前，在一个寒冷的冬夜，有一个想要更多屏幕时间的少年，和一位说“不行”的家长。

ex.s: The researchers observed that the dogs were much more patient, making more eye contact and staying closer to the screen after the “unable” scenario played out.
ex.t: 研究人员观察到，在“不能”的情景播放后，这些狗表现得更有耐心，更多地进行眼神交流，并更靠近屏幕。

ex.s: Another study from 2021 tested for “theory of mind” in dogs in a similar way, but the dogs were able to walk round the screen to obtain the treat after witnessing the experimenter’s “unwilling” or “unable” behaviour.
ex.t: 2021年的另一项研究以类似方式测试了狗的“心智理论”，但狗在目睹实验者“不情愿”或“无能为力”的行为后，能够绕到屏幕另一侧去取零食。

ex.s: However, what my children want to do after school is pick up a screen — any screen — and stare at it for hours.
ex.t: 然而，我的孩子们放学后想做的，是拿起一块屏幕——任何屏幕——然后盯着它看上几个小时。

ex.s: special clothes and a screen
ex.t: A．特殊服装和屏幕

ex.s: Of course, children aren’t completely to blame for their screen addiction.
ex.t: 虽然78%的父母说他们认为自己是良好的屏幕时间榜样，但研究发现他们的行为和他们对自己行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: While 78 percent of parents said they believed they were good screen time role models, the study found a disconnect between their behavior and their perception of their behavior.
ex.t: 虽然78%的父母说他们相信自己是有良好屏幕时间榜样的人，但研究发现他们的行为与他们对自身行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: Scott Fitzgerald’s most admired work will find themselves glued to their screens by episodes of The Great Gatsby.
ex.t: 菲茨杰拉德最受推崇的作品的爱好者，会被《了不起的盖茨比》的剧集牢牢吸引在屏幕前。

defs.def: the large flat surface that films/movies or pictures are shown on 银幕

ex.s: This means that great books can lose plot details and characters when they move to the big screen.
ex.t: 这意味着伟大的书籍在搬上大银幕时可能会丢失情节细节和人物。

defs.def: films/movies or television in general （统称）电影，电视
the data or images shown on a computer screen （电脑屏幕上）一屏的内容；画面

ex.s: The large board in the corner had been replaced by a big screen, where customers’ comments on the month’s best-seller were being displayed.
ex.t: 角落里的大板子已被一块大屏幕取代，屏幕上显示着顾客对当月畅销书的评论。

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: Documentary： A visual presentation （such as a video， slide show， or computer project） no more than 10 minutes long． A desktop computer， screen， projector， and loudspeakers will be available． Students must provide their presentations on CDs before Friday， March 23．
ex.t: 纪录片：一种视觉展示（如视频、幻灯片或电脑作品），时长不超过10分钟。将提供台式电脑、屏幕、投影仪和扬声器。学生必须在3月23日星期五之前将展示内容刻录在CD上提交。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到，他的孩子当时五岁三岁，被贴在屏幕上，以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: “We usually think in very concrete terms when doing something on a screen,” said Simone Schnall, senior author of the study.
ex.t: “我们在屏幕上做事情时，通常用非常具体的方式思考，”该研究的主要作者Simone Schnall说。

ex.s: They teased the dog by fixing the treat to the screen.
ex.t: 一次难忘的体育赛事。

ex.s: In the near future，it's not just going to be the number you see on your screen that will be in doubt.
ex.t: 在不久的将来，不仅仅是你在屏幕上看到的数字将受到质疑。

defs.def: a vertical piece of furniture or equipment that is fixed or that can be moved to divide a room or to keep one area hidden or separate 隔板；屏风；幕；帘；帐

ex.s: Both scenarios involved a dog being placed on one side of a glass screen with small holes in it at nose-height, and an experimenter standing on the other.
ex.t: 两种场景都是把狗放在一块玻璃屏风的一侧，屏风上在与狗鼻子齐高的位置有一些小孔，而实验员站在另一侧。

ex.s: And the stage was really simple: a decorated whip represented a horse, and a screen with Chinese characters, a study.
ex.t: 舞台其实很简单：一条装饰过的鞭子代表一匹马，一块写有汉字的屏风代表书房。

defs.def: something that prevents sb from seeing or being aware of sth, or that protects sb/sth 掩蔽物；掩护物；屏障；庇护
a wire or plastic net that is held in a frame and fastened on a window, or a door, to let in air but keep out insects 纱窗；纱门
a wood or stone structure in a church, that partly separates the main area from the altar or choir （拦在圣坛或唱诗班四周的木质或石砌）围屏
to hide or protect sth/sb by placing sth in front of or around them 掩藏；遮蔽；保护
to protect sb from sth dangerous or unpleasant, especially to protect sb who has done sth illegal or dishonest 庇护；包庇；袒护
to examine people in order to find out if they have a particular disease or illness 筛查；检查
to find out information about people who work or who want to work for you in order to make sure that they can be trusted 公司、组织等
to check sth to see if it is suitable or if you want it 审查；筛选
to show a film/movie, etc. in a cinema/movie theater or on television 放映（电影）；播放（电视节目）

ex.s: There is no doubt that the Bernina Express is a journey for travellers who want to get back to nature: the train window becomes the TV screen, and the natural world is the show.
ex.t: 毫无疑问，贝尔尼纳快车是为想要回归自然的旅行者准备的旅程：火车窗户变成了电视屏幕，自然界就是节目。
